name: xikibot
description: Extension of Zigbee2MQTT for home automation

scripts.build: eslint && packages/zigbee2mqtt/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/zigbee2mqtt/tsconfig.json && tsc && vitest run --config ./vitest.config.mts && node esbuild.config.mjs --prod
scripts.publish: eslint && packages/zigbee2mqtt/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/zigbee2mqtt/tsconfig.json && tsc && vitest run --config ./vitest.config.mts && node esbuild.config.mjs --prod && node scripts/publish.mjs
scripts.publish-dev: packages/zigbee2mqtt/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/zigbee2mqtt/tsconfig.json && tsc && node esbuild.config.mjs && node scripts/publish.mjs
